summary: Bound default validation to the published integration

delivery.outcome: A no-base gate on a clean published integration validates its first-parent diff, not an old adoption ticket's subsequent history.
nonGoals: No ticket terminal authority changes or edits to tickets 204 and 207.
No required-check or approval bypass; no target-repository edits here.

architecture.decision: Reuse the clean published integration observation for implicit adoption bases. Only origin's exact target HEAD with a readable first parent qualifies. Dirty, unpublished and unobservable states retain the accepted adoption base; explicit bases always win.
architecture.rollback: Adopt the previous immutable standard revision; no closure metadata is changed.

validation.evidence: Real Git regressions for clean published scope and conservative fallback.
Managed suites and protected Linux/Windows CI before independent merge.
